purpose: Draft external forensic replay candidates derived from Netflix's Chaos: The Manson Murders and stabilized against historical reporting rather than documentary speculation

sources.title: Chaos: The Manson Murders
sources.notes: Netflix describes the film as an exploration of the seven August 1969 murders and related conspiracy theories. It is useful for case discovery, but not sufficient as replay truth.

sources.title: What We Still Don't Know About the Manson Murders
sources.notes: Useful for confirming that the documentary primarily re-litigates the Tate-LaBianca murders while also interviewing Bobby Beausoleil about Gary Hinman.

sources.title: The True Story Behind 'Making Manson' Docuseries
sources.notes: Provides stable summary detail for the Hinman lead-up, captivity, blood writing, and the copycat framing theory around Tate and LaBianca.

sources.title: Charles Manson - Tate-LaBianca Murders
sources.notes: Useful stable reference for the Tate, LaBianca, Hinman, and Shea victim clusters and their sequence.

sources.title: Remembering the victims of the Manson murders
sources.notes: Useful for concise victim, location, and scene summaries without depending on the documentary's interpretive frame.

sources.title: The Manson 'family': A look at key players and victims in the cult leader's killings
sources.notes: Useful for compact victim and offender summaries and for keeping Hinman and Shea distinguished from the two-night Tate-LaBianca sequence.

sources.title: Tate first homicide investigation progress report
sources.notes: The report records witness sound windows at 00:30-01:00, 01:00-01:30, and a later 04:00-04:11 shot-report sequence on August 9, 1969.

sources.title: Tate-LaBianca Grand Jury Transcript - December 8, 1969 PM session
sources.notes: The transcript places the LaBiancas near home at about 1:00 AM on August 10 and confirms they were already dead by roughly 10:30 AM when Frank Struthers arrived.

cases.title: Sharon Tate / Cielo Drive murders
cases.metadata_basis: Netflix confirms this is one of the central August 1969 murders covered by the film; Britannica, LA Times, and AP provide stable victim and scene facts; the Tate progress report supplies witness sound windows for exploratory anchor probes.
soft_interpretations: copycat framing linked to Bobby Beausoleil's arrest
revenge for Terry Melcher or music-industry grievance
cases.not_replay_ready_reason: The date, place, victims, and staging are stable, but the sourced witness windows still span multiple candidate times. Exploratory route probes across those windows remained misaligned, repeatedly overfiring family and child axes on a non-family multi-offender homicide scene.
cases.recommended_next_step: Recover dispatch, coroner, or police reporting that narrows the active killing window enough for a defensible manual chart replay before promoting this case into an executable external slice. Engine-side review should then target the recurring family and child false positives before any promotion attempt.

cases.title: Gary Hinman murder
cases.metadata_basis: TIME confirms the documentary interviews Bobby Beausoleil about Hinman as a precursor event; Britannica, LA Times, and AP stabilize the victim, blood-writing, and arrest facts.

hard_outcomes.location: Old Topanga Canyon Road, Los Angeles County, California
known_scene_markers: blood writing intended to misdirect investigators

soft_interpretations: motive inflation by later case narratives
cases.not_replay_ready_reason: This is still the cleanest conceptual logic test in the cluster, but the recovered sources support a date and captivity narrative more than a tight event-time anchor. Exploratory probes across the murder date were unstable, alternating between missed homicide, public-case contamination, and even a disaster false positive.
cases.recommended_next_step: Recover case-file or trial-grade material that narrows the final assault window inside the captivity period before promoting this case into replay execution. Without that, the engine comparison is too sensitive to arbitrary intra-day anchor choice.
